title: CAT CATCHER
oneLiner: Dash through the moonlit rooftops and catch runaway yarn before the cats knock it away!
mechanics: A nimble cat runs automatically across rooftops.
Use left/right to dodge chimneys and leap between roof edges.
Catch glowing yarn balls to score points.
Missed yarn and obstacles cost a life; speed ramps up over time.
lose: Lose all three lives by hitting obstacles or falling from the rooftops.
scoring: Catch yarn balls for points, with bonus points for collecting several in a row.
